description:
FILED s466bd (Opus, 2026-09-03), found by a #995 probe (scratch/p995/16-hash-of-hash-loop.pl).
PRE-EXISTING: reproduced identically on a 57848f3 worktree, so #995 is not
its cause.  perl prints ok in every row below.

  my %h; my @a; my $r;
  $h{a}{b} .= "x"     CRASH   (perl: ok)
  $h{a}{b} += 1       CRASH   (perl: ok)
  $a[0]{k} .= "x"     CRASH   (perl: ok)
  $r->{a}{b} .= "x"   CRASH   (perl: ok)
  $h{a}{b} ||= 5      ok
  $h{a}{b}++          ok
  $h{a}{b} = 7        ok
  $h{a}[0] .= "x"     ok

THE CAUSE IS ONE ACCESSOR CHOICE, visible in the emission:

  $h{a}{b} .= "x"  ->  (p-.=      (p-gethash     (p-gethash     %h "a") "b") "x")
  $h{a}{b} += 1    ->  (p-incf    (p-gethash     (p-gethash     %h "a") "b") 1)
  $h{a}{b}++       ->  (p-post++  (p-gethash-box (p-gethash-box %h "a") "b"))

`++` lowers the whole access chain through the AUTOVIVIFYING box accessor
`p-gethash-box`; the coercing compound assigns lower it through the plain
READ accessor `p-gethash`, whose inner call answers `:undef` for a missing
key â and the outer `p-gethash` then gets `:undef` where it wants a
hash-table and dies with an SBCL type error, not a perl-shaped one.  `||=`
and `=` escape because they take different lowering paths (`p-setf` /
`p-or=` over the element place).

WHY THE MATRIX MATTERS: `$h{a}[0] .= "x"` WORKS while `$a[0]{k} .= "x"`
crashes, so the bug is not "nested access under a compound assign" as a
whole â it is per accessor pair, which is what a fix has to enumerate.  Do
that enumeration from the ONE place that builds an access chain rather than
per operator (rule 11).

BAR when taken: probes for every pair in the matrix above plus the deref-root
spellings ($r->{a}{b}, $$r{a}{b}, @{$r}{â¦}), the gate, corpus-diff, and the
full sweep â a fix that starts vivifying where nothing vivified before can
turn a read into a write (perl vivifies on the LHS of a compound assign, so
the direction is right, but `exists $h{a}` after the statement is the probe
that proves it).
=== DONE (s470bk) ===
FIXED, own commit, runtime-only, on top of #1058.

THE CAUSE WAS THE STORE, not the read: `%store-back-form` builds
`(setf PLACE (op PLACE VALUE))` and the setf WRITER of `p-gethash`/`p-aref`
cannot vivify its container â it is handed a VALUE.  (The READ half was always
safe: `p-gethash` answers `*p-undef*` for an undef container.)

RULE 11 â THE MECHANISM ALREADY EXISTED: `expand-autoviv` /
`expand-autoviv-for-array`, the compile-time place-chain walker `p-setf`
reaches through `p-autoviv-set`, which already knows all four chain links and
is the IDENTITY on a non-chain container.  One helper
(`%p-vivified-elem-form`) binds the container through it and the key beside it;
`%store-back-form` grows a third arm for a NESTED element place.  All thirteen
`%define-compound-pair` ops plus `&.=` `|.=` `^.=` are fixed by that one place.

WHY NOT `p-setf` â MEASURED, and it is the reason the fix binds the container:
`p-setf`'s nested arm stores with a RAW `(setf (gethash â¦))` which REPLACES the
slot, so `my %m; $m{a}{b} = "x"; my $al = \$m{a}{b}; $m{a}{b} .= "y"` would
answer "x" where perl answers "xy".  The ordinary `(setf (p-gethash CONT KEY))`
keeps `%p-gethash-store`'s write-through rule.

`%p-store-back` DELETED â a SECOND spelling of the store decision that served
the three string-bitwise compounds and carried the identical crash.

STRUCTURAL: the walker's `eval-when` block MOVED 58 lines unchanged, above the
store-back vocabulary that now calls it (a forward call prints a compile
warning into output four gate files CAPTURE).  Verified a pure permutation with
`LC_ALL=C sort` â a LOCALE-COLLATING `sort` is NOT a valid check for this: it
reorders equal-collating lines and reported 2542 spurious differences.

Guard `Pl/t/autoviv-02.t` 3 -> 5 rows, inverse-verified.  Residues filed:
#1150, #1151, #1152 (a FLAT element compound assign still evaluates its
container and key TWICE â the one-predicate widening that finishes it changes a
very hot shape and wants the full sweep an agent brief does not run).
subject: CRASH (pre-existing): a COERCING compound assign to a NESTED element does not autovivify the intermediate container â `$h{a}{b} .= "x"` dies "Value of pcl::h ... is :undef, not a hash-table"
